notes.title: [Common Q&A]
notes.content:
0.What is the state of the game?
[Prototype/Demo] -> [Playtest/Closed Beta] -> [Early Access] -> [Full Release]
 ㅤ    ㅤ    ㅤ    ㅤ   ^
 ㅤ    ㅤ    ㅤ   "We're here"

1.What's the difference between "Playtest" and "Demo"?
"Playtest" branch is the one that's currently in development. It will get updates/mantainance/resets. "Demo" is an earlier version of the game, think of it an prototype. It is not mantained nor updated.

2.Why can't I choose a server?
The servers are not official during develment. Meaning there is no choosing server.

3.My game crash on launch.
We use Unreal Engine 5 and its minimal system requirement. The game doesn't stress the GPU/CPU beyond the minimal requirement. But we do have higher graphic through in game settings.

4.I cannot log in with Google.
Please inform the service team through discord to see if the server is down. Provide extra detail if you can.

5.Why can't I just use Steam account to log in?
There is a plan to replace Google account with Steam account. But for developement purpose we are using Google account for the log in process for now.

6.Does this game come out on platforms other than PC?(Switch or mobile...)
Not until the game is fully developed. Currently there won't be extra resources to port the game to other platforms.

7.My game crashes while entering Sky Island?
Some crashes are caused by the mismatch versions of the map due to constent development. We suggest try verifying game file through steam. Right click Utopia No.8 in Steam library -> Properties -> Installed Files -> Verify integrity of beta files
If you still experience crashes. Please inform us through Discord or Steam community with your computer spec, mainly CPU and RAM size.

8.How do I play and where do I start?
As of now, the majority of content is on the Sky Island. There you gather trees/mines "daily" and do farming/ranching/fishing. Some Npcs on island act as shop or quests turn in. The goal is to upgrade island structures level. And with the resources you can craft furnitures for decorating and clothing for your avatar!

The game is still in development and constant changing. We aren't going to make official tutorial until the majority of the content are set and done. But we would record video showing how to access contents in the game. 
Example Tutorial for v1.0.7: 
[previewyoutube=D8UKCAUbhUM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










9.How to get into Utopia no.8 Playtest?
You can request a key code in Discord. Or directly "Request Access" on Utopia no.8 store page where the key would automatically redeem for you during our weekly keys distribution.  

10.How do I redeem the playtest key?
On your steam library page, there would be a button call "Add a Game."(button left) > "Activate a Product on Steam" > Enter the key code.   The game would be added to your library.

11.Will my account progress be reset before the game release? 
No, your account progress will "NOT" be saved for the game release. We also reset them during Playtest for update purpose.

12.What is the game monetization model?
We lean toward Free to Play but the actual model is to be determined at this stage of development.

If you have any questions or suggestions, please feel free to share them with us in-game or in our communities.

Best regards,
Team at Happy Tomato.

notes.title: v1.0.7 Version Update
notes.content:
Version 1.0.7 Update – Economic Revamp

▼ Important Note!
[olist]
With the economic system revamp, player characters have been wiped. Please make new character to experience the new economic system.
[/olist]

▼ New Content
[olist]
1. New furniture type “Processor” where you can make new items from raw materials. With different type of processors and recipes, like wood to planks, ore to metal ingots.
2. New way of getting fish with “Fish Cage.” Players can access the menu through fish information robot near fishing spots. 
3. NPC merchant at Sci-fi City now sells Blueprints for clothing and furniture.
4. New personal info tab on the top left player icon. One can leave a message and access closet features. You can also check on other player’s info tab by clicking on others!
5. New animals for ranch! Level your island star to lv4 and get them as new rewards!
6. Mailbox feature, where players receive official messages and rewards in the future.
7. Broadcast feature, where players receive notification from server events. Like if someone reached lv3 on Island Star!
[/olist]

▼ Optimization & Changes
[olist]
1. Change many of the items gain amount, the price, the way of obtain.
2. Ranch UI changes.
3. Decoration UI changes. With new rotation/grid/menu functions.
4. Fishing information UI now can access fish cage management.
5. New statues in the middle of the island lake according to player’s fishing level.
6. Changes to some NPC locations.
7. Naming and description changes to furniture and clothing.
8. Newly created character would receive default clothing in their closet.
9. Key “Tab” now finds nearby player and show icon on the top left corner.
10. Key “Ctrl + F” now cycle through current overlapping interacting targets.
[/olist]

▼ Bug Fixes
[olist]
1. Fix English translations.
2. Fix some text out of UI boundary.
3. Fix some scene bugs.
[/olist]

If you have any questions or suggestions, please feel free to share them with us in-game or in our communities.

Best regards,
Team at Happy Tomato.

Hello~ 

Latest dev log is here!
Let’s what changes had been done in May.

We revisit the economic system to reduce the workflow required for player island. And the added NPC in the city sells blueprints for clothing and furniture now. No longer require luck to get the blueprints that are not yet unlocked!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787407/fa3a74652b33cd2f46df11370391c865f952f6ac.jpg[/img] 
We also changed some clothing and furniture names so players can identify them better.

With the new eco system we also changed the rewards for upgrading island star. Once reach the highest level, you’d get rainbow animals as rewards! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787407/4b41e7e1d8dc2ac7427ee6324661dbf2c9f7caf1.jpg[/img]

See you next update! <3

notes.title: December 2023 Dev Update
notes.content:
Hi there! Better late than never, the December Development Update is here!

And oh boy, do we have a huge surprise to share with all of you!

Drumroll, please!
We're excited to announce that on January 22, 2024, at 11:00 AM (GMT+8), we will kick off the Beta Test! Same as in Alpha, all the gaming data will be wiped out after the test.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787407/979112123bd6899813819bd32da75fe2f5b0b986.jpg[/img]

It's time to meet you all again!
While the game is still a bit away from our expected vision, we wanted to show you our current progress! So, we've decided to give all our supporting Utokers a sneak peek of the island gameplay of "Utopia No.8" with this early test.

Since it's a testing version, you might encounter some peculiar bugs, so please approach the game with a "let's have fun and hunt bugs" attitude!

Of course, if you come across anything you find abnormal or issues that should be fixed, please be the first to report it in our game communities! We'll make sure to address it promptly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787407/4eb7b182840f80a1a33aec47b73a66efe63c71c3.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787407/a94a46b315b147ba0477a4a4fd8d99ff877ef186.jpg[/img]

During this testing phase, various stress tests will be conducted on the system, leading to occasional system maintenance and updates! We apologize in advance for any inconvenience!

Lastly,
Thank you, dear Utokers! We'll keep pushing forward in the new year!

Best regards from the Happy Tomato Entertainment Team

notes.title: November 2023 Dev Update
notes.content:
November 2023 Dev Update

Hey, long time no see, everyone!
It's that time again to unveil the mysteries in our monthly development update! 
Let's see what exciting things we've added in the past month!

First off, let me introduce to all you Utokers our brand-new system—drumroll, please! The Synthesis System has arrived!
What makes this system so fun? Well, you get to roll up your sleeves, gather various materials, and craft your very own goodies!
From collecting materials to the entire crafting process, it's a challenge you'll surely enjoy, as you become a master creator!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787407/05256861d10a7376db219d1ec28d35c42d6ef0ce.png[/img]

The entire world of UTO8 is our treasure trove. Explore every inch of land, find all sorts of magical elements, unleash boundless creativity, and adorn your own space!
And when you're tired, find a shady spot for a leisurely break, enjoy the beauty of your island, browse through your collected loot, and savor the satisfaction of your achievements!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787407/711c42e70f4ffc3975f5dcb724e9c8cc8346191a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787407/4957869e371c743de19ab4b891c9d70d09ace5dc.gif[/img]

Apart from materials, blueprints for crafting are also a must! Without them, going from 0 to 1 isn't as simple as it sounds! You can obtain these blueprints by interacting with the NPCs on the island, fulfilling their requests, and completing tasks!
If your friends have blueprints you need, you can exchange them with each other!
Just like collecting Pokémon, let's increase our blueprint completion together <3
As the blueprint catalog unlocks, unexpected functionalities might come into play!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787407/f2042f88e8817adb760dc82b76a7be923ff2996c.png[/img]

Finally, dear Utokers, please enjoy the scenic views of our beautiful island <3

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787407/596a6cb43d566431f28a9ca0c770b7e5508bc08a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787407/43b0307cc68a6ebd9a33c68eab3771aa5e70746a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787407/268c5cf47b758f38f5e12120be55117f1e2baf1f.png[/img]

Alright, that wraps up this month's development update!
Thanks, everyone, see you next month!


Best regards,
Happy Tomato Entertainment Team

notes.title: October 2023 Dev Update
notes.content:
Hey, here we are again, and October's weather sure can't make up its mind, right?

But, as is tradition, it's time for this month's development update, so let's take a look at our latest updates and plans!

First and foremost, we've added a brand-new quest to our islands – the Island Star! Island Star holds tremendous potential; in its pristine state, it can harness mysterious powers, infusing everything around it with vitality. However, after the relentless passage of time, the current Island Star has seen better days, and its waning energy is gradually affecting all islands, resulting in disruptions to the natural order of things. Only by fully restoring Island Star can the entire environment thrive once more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787407/61ba51bceff80cee59ddbe995d8c1e6f677af4ec.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787407/3001c2db319738683034ca49d460494cb635ca6f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787407/d700d4f1bf29c3f514b9c4fd0953f0e0299384d1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787407/68ca5737bea0c1290261d4e75e34d7b0541456a5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787407/d8a4d65ba7285517156b7713297c768b76b5fa46.png[/img]

We invite each of our Utoker partners to join in the monumental task of restoring Island Star! Simultaneously, the island's villagers will wholeheartedly support us. Utokers will follow in the footsteps of the villagers, exploring each of the islands step by step, completing a wide range of quests to unlock seals on facilities and items. As you progress through your adventures, you'll also uncover the unique characteristics of each island. With the advancement of your journey, the splendor of the islands will be restored!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787407/1676ab1b5c7e96ee59eb51d2cc5d02e5198548fc.png[/img]

Throughout this process, blessings from Island Star and a variety of mysterious items will serve as rewards for exploration and quest completion. As for the significance of these blessing fragments and what you can do with these items—well, we'll keep in secret for now!

Next, let's head over to the ranch and see what's new there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787407/6f091804bdb8152e5b9427316fce212f3fcd6cfe.gif[/img]

How could an exceptional ranch not have adorable little calves, right? Here they are, jumping with excitement to say hello to us!

Taking into account the villagers' preferences, we've decided to facilitate island-to-island transportation through hot air balloons. These balloons provide a leisurely, scenic view of the mountains from above, which aligns perfectly with the villagers' laid-back nature. Let's take a look!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787407/1b4f6f3c9ef3cfea91cd8dd570efc7ca40dddc91.png[/img]

Unlocking these hot air balloons will involve completing a series of quests. It's like a hands-on creative experience! The specifics of how they operate will be revealed in due time.

Finally, we want to express our gratitude for your ongoing attention, and we're also very thankful to the Utokers who've provided feedback in the community. With your support, UTO8 is steadily and surely making progress.

Thank you all, and until next time!



Best regards,
Happy Tomato Entertainment Team

notes.title: September 2023 Dev Update
notes.content:
Hi Utokers, it's great to see you again!

It's time for us to share the latest updates on our development progress this month. Let's take a look at what we've been up to!

First, let's talk about the scene design sketches!

We're introducing the concept art for four brand-new personal islands! Unlike the tech-focused style during the Alpha Test, this time around, we've decided to go for a rural countryside theme (though there will still be some tech elements, of course). By creating environments in various styles, we believe we can achieve our initial vision of creating a beautiful new world that can accommodate everyone. Since it's meant to be an inclusive world, the variety of styles is a must. What you're seeing now is just the beginning—stay tuned for further developments!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787407/d39132a0b619c055212dca59865aeaab41d9c7d1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787407/226e09b03a170b86588292fca799f111f62f9b83.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787407/fa72a19b3e8f1cbd18e1850e54310f35c136c65a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787407/e1fa9d831beb7d1aa26b19344a95e83562049f35.png[/img]

Now, let's delve into one of these islands—the Forest Town!

This will be the first island that Utokers land on after arriving on the planet. Players will embark on a series of quests here to gradually unlock various island features! What we're revealing today is a glimpse of the rest area in our Forest Town. Here, you'll encounter many island residents, each with their own unique characteristics. There's the gentle and knowledgeable Wooly, the confident Sable, and the tender Buddy. They will guide Utokers step by step in understanding the planet Utopia No.8 and join you on adventures and exploration on the island!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787407/00180069372c90d201f9e5715b894e51f7def0f5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787407/14e88fddf5a9e4623d4cbbf8c5a81fef910e6223.jpg[/img]

Finally, we want to express our gratitude for your continuous support and attention! We'll keep creating new content to make UTO8 the best it can be.

Thank you, and we'll see you next month!

Best regards,
Happy Tomato Entertainment Team

notes.title: August 2023 Dev Update
notes.content:
Hi there, dear Utokers!

It's that time again for our development catch-up, where we get to share our latest progress with all of you! This update is bound to bring you surprises one after another, so let's dive right in!

First, let's talk about what's already completed:
The "360 Occupations, Each with its Own Expertise" fashion line, featuring two brand-new sets of outfits, is fully designed in 3D! Introducing the Police Outfit and the Teacher Outfit this time. More occupational outfits are also in full swing! Stay tuned for those.

We believe this special addition will be a major highlight, and all players will have the opportunity to explore and appreciate its grandeur and beauty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787407/1433f343a96229225c54d4594c494fe82ba30536.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787407/9463c56f954ddb5aab1579b5b8223af9cb2f908a.jpg[/img]
 
Thank you all for your continuous support and attention. You are our most valued partners. Let's look forward to how the game will evolve in the future, together!

Thank you, and see you in the next month's development update!


With love,
Happy Tomato Team

notes.title: May 2023 Dev Update
notes.content:
Hey! Let's talk about our first development update report! We are thrilled to share with you the latest progress on "Utopia No.8." Without further ado, let's dive into the updates! 

First and foremost, we have prepared a brand-new concept art for the game's world setting! Compared to the previously released information, we have added more details and new areas. Our goal is to provide all Utokers with a richer gaming experience, allowing you to explore this fantastical new world and gain a better understanding of Utopia No.8!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787407/049829f986ccc7b605d8da4600a6a38a44b358e7.jpg[/img]

In addition, we have made improvements to the dialogue system by introducing many new UI options. To enhance NPC interactions in the future, we have added more interactive choices. Players can look forward to fully enjoying the fun of engaging with the characters in the game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787407/d6f03917a2d14f94ebc680c083b98e28ed10bf70.jpg[/img]

Lastly, let's talk about the newly designed costumes! We have added a variety of exquisite costume designs to the game, showcasing your most fashionable and unique side. Whether you want to portray a trendy idol or a brave adventurous hero, you'll find the perfect outfit that suits your style! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787407/01b1ad8ecccb6c863001d751fe98f0fadf574503.png[/img]

Some of these updates will be included in the ALPHA TEST happening in June!

We aim to create an unforgettable gaming experience for players through continuous improvements. Thank you all for your ongoing support and attention! This is our first development diary, and we will continue to share more exciting content with all of you!

Thank you, and see you in the June Alpha Test!

Best,
Happy Tomato Team
